title: Chapter 1366 - 30: Temporal Lifeform "Galaxy" (End Of This Volume)
content:
Chapter 1366 - 30: Temporal Lifeform "Galaxy" (End Of This Volume)

Chapter 1366: Chapter 30: Temporal Lifeform "Galaxy" (End of This Volume)

"Correct."

"Galaxy, you’re still too modest."

The owner of the Sky Void Tripod also spoke.

"Galaxy, you should have completely surpassed my strength by now."

Lord Mo Xu asked tentatively.

From the moment Lin Yuan broke through, engulfing the Chaos Void with such commotion.

Apart from anything else, just in terms of sheer size, he has certainly surpassed Lord Mo Xu.

"It’s merely brute force."

Lin Yuan said.

If there weren’t the rank of Lord.

Even if the size of strength is surpassed, it’s just a little more brute force.

"Brute force?"

Lord Mo Xu did not agree.

If strength forms a crush, what does it matter if you cannot observe any timeline?

For example, when the Second Realm faces the First Realm, even if the former doesn’t observe the timeline, the First Realm will still be helpless against the latter.

"Let’s go."

"Let’s have a good gathering today."

"To celebrate Galaxy stepping into the Twelfth Rank."

Lord Mo Xu said.

Lin Yuan did not refuse either.

Stepping into the Thirteenth Rank, becoming a time life form.

It’s indeed a joyous occasion, worth celebrating.

...

The first Origin World.

When Lin Yuan broke through the time cycle and stepped into the Twelfth Rank.

This Origin World simultaneously gave birth to a tremendous phenomenon.

"What’s that?"

"Ancestor, a new Ancestor is born."

"It’s the Galaxy Venerate, the Galaxy Venerate has become an Ancestor."

"The Galaxy Venerate will open the Seventh Ancient Country and become the new Ancestor."

...

Many Venerates felt a huge concentration of aura, their hearts were extremely shaken.

This is an Ancestor.

The Seventh Ancestor.

"Has Galaxy become an Ancestor?"

In Qingfen Domain, Lord Qingfen felt a significant change in his causality link with this aura, his thoughts deeply moved.

He remembered the first time he met Lin Yuan when the latter was an exceptionally weak being.

But now, this weak being has grown to a height that even he cannot look up to.

...

In the Ancient Country of Da Ling.

King Lingshen also felt the phenomenon of the new Ancestor’s birth.

"Is it the Galaxy Venerate?"

King Lingshen remained silent, then shook his head, saying: "I never thought that one day, I would be able to confront an Ancestor?"

During the past wars between Qingfen Domain and Purple Dream Domain, King Lingshen intervened, but was blocked by Lin Yuan and even lost his life to the latter.

Now that Galaxy has become the new Ancestor, the once defeat turned into a place of pride for King Lingshen.

Losing to the hands of an Ancestor.

It’s an honor.

...

"Hahahaha, congratulations to Galaxy."

"Congratulations, congratulations."

Da Fu Ancestor and the other six Ancestors gathered with Lin Yuan in an independent space-time.

"Thanks to all of you for allowing me to embody."

Lin Yuan said.

Before breaking through to the Thirteenth Rank, Lin Yuan specifically experienced the perspective of embodying the six Ancestors.

"Galaxy, when do you plan to establish the Seventh Ancient Country?"

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun asked.

In this Origin World, it is customary for each Ancestor to establish an Ancient Country.

Time life forms in the Chaos Void generally do not interfere with matters below the Thirteenth Rank, leaving behind only some legacies.

But the time life forms in this Origin World are different, as they will establish Ancient Countries to cultivate their descendants and offspring.

"In a while."

"I’ll wait until my realm stabilizes."

Lin Yuan said.

Compared to the Chaos Void which can endure Origin Source infusion.

In this Origin World, when Lin Yuan stepped into the Thirteenth Rank, he didn’t gain much benefit.

So in terms of strength, he has just barely reached the milestone of Second Realm, not like the original self in Chaos Void that immediately surpassed most Second Realm levels.

Therefore.

Lin Yuan’s next step is to enhance his strength to the limit.

"Indeed."

Da Fu Ancestor and the other five ancestors nodded.

For the ancestors, the most important aspect is themselves.

As for establishing ancient countries to nurture descendants? That’s secondary.

Even for Da Fu Ancestor, who values his descendants the most, if his personal cultivation conflicts with that of the ancient country’s offspring.

He would undoubtedly choose the former without hesitation.

...

The second Origin Source World.

Lin Yuan steps into the Thirteenth Rank, causing the great Dao of the world to tremble.

"The Eternal Lord, a new Eternal Lord has been born."

In the hidden world, several Sect Masters wept. Even though they knew Lin Yuan’s strength was not inferior to the Eternal Lord.

But as long as he does not become the Eternal Lord, he must face the barrier of time cycles.

If he cannot overcome it, even the strongest Free Three Realms will completely fall.

Now that Lin Yuan has become the Eternal Lord, he can swim freely like fish in the sea, without any hidden threats.

"Demon God?"

After stepping into the Thirteenth Rank, Lin Yuan’s power surged, and at the moment, there are no secrets in the entire Origin Source World in his eyes.

Even the hiding place of the Demon God, the deepest part of the Origin Source World, is under Lin Yuan’s gaze.

Rumble.

Lin Yuan lifts his right hand.

An immense and boundless Taiji Yin Yang Diagram converges, spinning continuously and instantly enveloping the entire Origin Source World.

Rumble.

The Black and White Tai Chi Force quickly erodes the dark Demonic Qi.

Buzz~ The Demon God’s form gathers, its hollow gaze fixed on Lin Yuan.

"Coming out willingly?"

Lin Yuan also looks at the Demon God.

At this moment, Lin Yuan has completely risen to the Thirteenth Rank, becoming the Eternal Lord, with the position supported by the Lord of Heaven Light, standing out within the Demon God’s vision.

Just as Lin Yuan was preparing to subdue the Demon God and completely end the demonic catastrophe.

The Demon God’s hollow gaze revealed a hint of emotion between its eyes.

"You’ve inherited my rank; naturally, everything of mine is yours." The Demon God smiled, gazing at Lin Yuan.

Its gaze was gentle, filled with goodwill.

Though surrounded by boundless Demonic Qi, yet giving an illusion of infinite brightness.

"But remember, the path I’ve taken is now unworkable; my rank, at most, serves as a reference, never to be refined."

After speaking, the demon’s body began to disintegrate, and all the Demonic Qi permeating everywhere in the world turned into the purest and most elemental force, converging before Lin Yuan.

"Hmm?"

Lin Yuan watched this scene, the timeline constantly reversing, returning to the long past, at the time when the Lord of Heaven Light attempted to break through to the Fourteenth Rank.

In the moment when attempting to break through the Fourteenth Rank failed, the Lord of Heaven Light realized this, but was powerless to manage, unable to extinguish the bright body and Black Demon body.

So with its final force, it forcibly disintegrated its lordly position.

Let the lordly position merge into the beings of this world.

Such an approach had two purposes.

One was to weaken the strength of the Black Demon body and the bright body as much as possible.

It could be foreseen that if the lordly position did not shatter, merely relying on this Origin Source World’s thirteen Eternal Lords would never be enough to stop the out-of-control Lord of Heaven Light.

Even if it was only a bright body.

The second purpose was that someday, should an Eternal Lord reconverge the lordly position of the Lord of Heaven Light, then he could voluntarily accept everything of this Time Lord.

Whether it be the Black Demon body.

Or the bright body.

"Lord of Heaven Light..."

Lin Yuan gazed at the deep crystal clearly formed by the boundless Demonic Qi.

To condense a lordly position within the creatures, was the Lord of Heaven Light leaving the beings of this world a lifeline.

It’s just a pity that none of the thirteen Eternal Lords saw this lifeline, yet Lin Yuan stumbled upon it, using the Martial Arts Evolution Road to converge it.

"There..."

Lin Yuan raised his gaze beyond the Origin Source World.

By relying on the lordly position, Lin Yuan sensed there was a force very close to him, estimated to be where the Lord of Heaven Light’s bright body resided.

...

In the time and space shrouded by infinite brightness.

The thirteen Eternal Lords also perceived changes within the Origin Source World.

However, before they could respond, the infinite brightness constantly enveloping them quickly dissipated.

Meanwhile.

A new figure appeared.

It was Lin Yuan.

"Greetings, everyone."

Lin Yuan smiled at the thirteen Eternal Lords.

"Galaxy?" The Master of Infinite slightly stunned, looked around, couldn’t resist asking: "The teacher’s bright body..."

"Is here." Lin Yuan flipped his right hand, and a crystal condensed with boundless light emerged.

The thirteen Eternal Lords stared, dumbfounded, at the crystal of light in Lin Yuan’s palm.

The bright body that had dragged them through long ages was so easily resolved by Lin Yuan?
